instruction: Candid cinematic still, medium close-up. Outdoors in a sunny grassy field, a group of friends relaxes. In the foreground, the man in the olive shirt (R3) wraps his arms around the red-haired woman (R2) from behind in a warm embrace. The red-haired woman, wearing a black off-shoulder top, smiles happily with closed eyes, while the man in the olive shirt smiles warmly. In the left background, the man with glasses (R4) sits in a striped shirt, looking away to the side. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the scene, creating a warm color palette and a soft-focus background.
